briefings.headline: Von der Leyen Demands Stronger EU Borders After Ceuta Migrant Surge
briefings.body: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called for action on border security ahead of an urgent EU interior ministers meeting convened to address migrant crossings at Ceuta. The emergency gathering signals mounting pressure on EU member states to coordinate a response to the situation at the Spanish enclave on the northern coast of Africa, a flashpoint for migration into Europe.

sources.title: EU calls for stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings

briefings.why_it_matters: Decisions made at this emergency ministers meeting could reshape EU border and migration policy in ways that affect asylum seekers, member states' obligations, and the broader debate over Europe's external frontiers.

briefings.headline: SNAP Rolls Shed 4 Million Recipients as Cuts Reshape Food Aid
briefings.body: More than 4 million people have stopped receiving SNAP benefits since last July, as the federal food-stamp program undergoes sweeping cuts and structural changes. The decline has been rapid and consistent across that period. SNAP, which serves as the primary federal nutrition safety net for low-income Americans, is facing what officials and advocates describe as historic reductions in both eligibility and funding.

sources.title: Over 4 million people are no longer receiving food aid amid sweeping changes to SNAP

briefings.why_it_matters: Millions of households that previously relied on SNAP to cover grocery costs are now navigating that expense without federal assistance.

briefings.headline: 2026 Volkswagen Jetta Sport Starts at $25,305
briefings.body: Volkswagen's 2026 Jetta Sport enters the market at $25,305, making it one of the cheapest new cars available. The price positions it as a rare budget option in a new-car market that has trended sharply upward in recent years. The review notes the vehicle reflects its price point, offering affordability without premium features or performance.

sources.title: 2026 Volkswagen Jetta Sport: The cheap car isn't completely extinct yet

briefings.why_it_matters: For buyers priced out of the average new car, the Jetta Sport is one of the few remaining options under $26,000 from a major automaker.

briefings.headline: Trump Opens Pacific Monument Waters to Commercial Fishing
briefings.body: The Trump administration is lifting protections on U.S. marine monuments in the Pacific Ocean, opening their waters to commercial fishing. The affected areas, centered on remote island chains, are among the largest conservation zones in the country and host some of the most biodiverse and pristine ocean ecosystems in the United States. The move has triggered a dispute between conservation advocates and those supporting expanded fishing access.

sources.title: These are some of the last pristine ocean ecosystems. Now, they're losing protections

briefings.why_it_matters: Weakened monument protections could accelerate damage to reef ecosystems and fish populations that once recovered behind federal boundaries — affecting seafood supplies and ocean health for generations.

briefings.headline: 440 Private Colleges At Risk as Campus Closings Accelerate
briefings.body: More than 440 private nonprofit four-year colleges and universities nationwide are now at risk of closing, driven by falling enrollment, rising debt, and related financial pressures. The pace of closings is accelerating, producing a growing market in abandoned campuses. Burlington College in Vermont, which closed in 2016, stands as an early example of the trend now spreading more broadly across American higher education.

sources.title: Pace of college closings picks up, with more projected

briefings.why_it_matters: If your family is weighing a private college enrollment decision, the financial stability of the institution is now a real variable — students caught in a sudden closure can lose credits, financial aid, and academic momentum.

briefings.headline: Spokane Wildfires Destroy Hundreds of Homes, Force 60,000 to Evacuate
briefings.body: Wildfires burning in Spokane have destroyed hundreds of homes and triggered evacuation orders for 60,000 people. The fires have swept through residential areas, displacing tens of thousands of residents as emergency crews work to contain the blazes.

sources.title: Photos: Wildfires in Spokane lead to thousands of evacuations

briefings.why_it_matters: If you or someone you know lives in or near Spokane, evacuation orders remain active — follow local emergency alerts and have a go-bag ready.
